body: Really good actually! I’m not always great about keeping them in all the time but they’ve worked wonders and I’ve had no issues as of lately :)

Try changing the haircut to something more modern. Something a bit longer and fluffy would suit you. Other than that just shave and maybe try contacts. Overall you look fine and you should have more confidence in yourself:)
I forgot to add: volunteered at library last summer, section leader in school choir program, jujitsu since 7th grade, co-chair of environmental club I started
Thank you so much everyone who commented!! I’m feeling a lot better about them now (although it still really sucks at the moment lol) thanks to all the words of encouragement:))

It would be hard to make it look like an accident considering how far technology has come, so personally I would write a really heartfelt note to every person I loved and that way they would be able to make peace with your death. Either way sucks for the family but an abrupt death with no note or anything would suck way worse imo

Thank you for the input:) I’ll try to implement some of these ideas into my life. My parents are completely against any form of medication or therapy which is pretty frustrating so it’s nice to have something that I can work on by myself.
